description: Maps – Your Geospatial Power BI Visual Explore your data with Maps, the intelligent and versatile visual for geospatial analytics in Power BI. New Highlights Custom map upload (GeoJSON & TopoJSON): Bring your own shapes, regions, and boundaries into Power BI with full formatting support. H3 grid support: Transform any built-in or custom map into an H3 hexagonal grid with selectable resolutions for scalable spatial analysis, density mapping, and grid-based reporting. Point binning and spatial aggregation: Automatically map point data to shapes or H3 cells and aggregate values for heatmaps, density analysis, spatial clustering, and area-based reporting. Built-in city geocoding and route creation: Create points and routes directly from city names using the included offline city dictionary (25,000+ population cities worldwide). A single city name creates a point, while multiple city names separated by "|" automatically create a route, reducing the need for manual coordinate management. True mini‑charts on the map: Create Column, Line, Pie, Donut, or Packed Bubble charts directly on points, routes, or shapes using categories as axes or legends. Moving Dashlines for flows and routes: Animate directional flows with smooth, configurable dashline motion to highlight movement, intensity, or direction. Key Features Flexible visualization: Choropleth maps, markers, routes, bubble charts,…
